items.author: amiibru.bsky.social
items.context: Well, if you like indie games, have you played Toem? It is a very cozy indie game where you solve puzzles by taking pictures.
items.text: Toem is a lovely pick. Taking photos to help people out is such a gentle puzzle loop.

items.author: violetadia.bsky.social
items.context: Who else is ready to get the frig out of work and go home and cuddle into some blankets with tea? Cozy games/movies/TV or books are a must..and a furry creature of some sort obvs. #cozy #friday #cuddle
items.text: Tea, blankets and a furry creature sounds like the perfect end to the week. Hope you get home soon!
